judge_notes: All three candidates returned zero assays; agreed. The study is entirely ex vivo whole-cell patch-clamp recording in acute OFc slices. It includes no behavioural test, so there is nothing to score under the rubric's exclusion of slice physiology.

Two candidates gave identity and housing fields; gemma4 gave none. I took species, strain, sex and housing from the paper's Methods ('Male Sprague Dawley rats (280-350 g) were group-housed... 12-h light/dark cycles... unrestricted access to food and water').
The 25C-NBOMe dosing entry (30 μM, route 'other', acute) is retained because two of the three candidates included it, so it is the modal answer.
Note on that dosing entry: 25C-NBOMe was bath-applied to brain slices and never given to live animals, so no mg/kg doses exist.
DOI is set to null because the markdown contains no DOI and neither candidate supplied one.
Age is set to 'adult' because the Abstract says 'adult male Sprague Dawley rats'. No age in days is given, only body weight of 280-350 g.
